scripts.deploy:website: npm run website:build:live && firebase deploy --only hosting --project ${SAYSPEC_FIREBASE_PROJECT:?Set SAYSPEC_FIREBASE_PROJECT to your Firebase project ID}
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage,functions --project ${SAYSPEC_FIREBASE_PROJECT:?Set SAYSPEC_FIREBASE_PROJECT to your Firebase project ID}
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sayspec/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sayspec/functions && npm run typecheck -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sayspec/contracts && npm run test -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native: npm run build && npm run test:native -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native:runs: npm run build && npm run test:native:runs -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native:managed-fix: npm run build && npm run test:native:managed-fix -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native:recording: npm run build && npm run test:native:recording -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native:transcription: npm run build && npm run test:native:transcription -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:native:generation: npm run build && npm run test:native:generation -w @sayspec/desktop
scripts.test:emulator:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-sayspec-local "node firebase/scripts/seed-auth.mjs && node firebase/scripts/auth-emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:native:auth: npm run build:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-sayspec-local "node firebase/scripts/seed-auth.mjs && SAYSPEC_AUTH_SMOKE=1 npm run test:native -w @sayspec/desktop"
scripts.test:packaged:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-sayspec-local "node firebase/scripts/seed-auth.mjs && npm run test:packaged:auth -w @sayspec/desktop"
scripts.test:packaged:auth-persistence: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-sayspec-local "node firebase/scripts/seed-auth.mjs && npm run test:packaged:auth-persist-in -w @sayspec/desktop && npm run test:packaged:auth-persist-out -w @sayspec/desktop"
scripts.test:native:flutter-share: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-flutter-share-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:recording-share: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-recording-share-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:workspace: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-workspace-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:settings: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-settings-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:project-gate: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-project-gate-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:library: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-library-native.mjs
scripts.test:native:managed-fix:pro: npm run build -w @sayspec/functions && npm run build:emulator && node firebase/scripts/run-managed-fix-pro-native.mjs
